mapper.insert: insert into article(title, summary, content, category_id, cover, status, is_top, is_hot, view_num, like_num, comment_num, create_time, update_time, publish_time, user_id, user_nickname, user_avatar, delete_flag, sort) VALUES (#{title},#{summary},#{content},#{categoryId},#{cover},#{status},#{isTop},#{isHot}, #{viewNum},#{likeNum},#{commentNum},#{createTime},#{updateTime},#{publishTime}, #{userId},#{userNickname},#{userAvatar},#{deleteFlag},#{sort})
mapper.update:
UPDATE article
title = #{title},
summary = #{summary},
content = #{content},
category_id = #{categoryId},
cover = #{cover},
status = #{status},
is_top = #{isTop},
is_hot = #{isHot},
publish_time = #{publishTime},
update_time = #{updateTime}, timed_publish_time = #{timedPublishTime},
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.category_id, a.cover, a.status, a.is_top, a.is_hot, a.view_num, a.like_num, a.comment_num, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.publish_time, a.timed_publish_time, a.user_id, a.sort, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, c.name AS category_name, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM tag t INNER JOIN article_tag at ON t.id = at.tag_id WHERE at.article_id = a.id ) AS tags_str from article a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id
a.delete_flag = 1
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND a.status = #{status}
ORDER BY a.update_time DESC, a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.category_id, a.cover, a.status, a.is_top, a.is_hot, a.view_num, a.like_num, a.comment_num, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.publish_time, a.timed_publish_time, a.user_id, a.sort, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, c.name AS category_name, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM tag t INNER JOIN article_tag at ON t.id = at.tag_id WHERE at.article_id = a.id ) AS tags_str from article a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
